notes: Codex Desktop routing cases. Positives cover the explicitly selected Codex-sidebar or ChatGPT-web surface, body-derived titles, same-workstream relevance, and recurring Codex-sidebar organization. A generic request that does not identify a surface needs a routing question, not a blended inventory. Negatives protect other clients, generic Git cleanup, ordinary single-chat summaries, and browser-extension work. The held_out split is the final untouched test set, matching the repository's active-skill eval convention.
